scorer.approximation_notice: Research approximation of the Armantier et al. (2017) Appendix C generalized-beta fit, selected on a preregistered holdout; not the official FRBNY implementation. The same algorithm scores real and simulated questionnaires; differences from official headline values are reported separately.

median_convention: existing project empirical quantile for Q9, interpolation for Q8; same for all arms and persistence; earlier preparation np.median diagnostics may differ for even n
limits: Previously examined development periods; no blind holdout registered.
Four per age group are a mechanism probe, not a nationally representative sample.
Current E is a fixed information treatment; some actual respondents answered before its cutoff.
Exact prior reminder is an information intervention, not proof of natural memory.
Equal-weight permutation preserves the stock of priors, not a survey-weighted stock.
Initialization is a historical conditional donor candidate; no regime shift correction, no certified historical B vintage.
Own prior persistence can improve levels without reproducing learning or rational updates.
Two repeats are candidate generations, not two new populations or provider-controlled random seeds.
Full prior reminder is a controlled intervention, not a measurement of natural memory.
Four previously inspected development periods; independent mechanism holdout remains to be registered.
Fresh contemporaneous no-prior arm avoids relying solely on old alias-version responses.
scope: curated aggregate receipt; full repeated/group diagnostics kept in ignored local outputs
